text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, a fan letter arrived for Curren 
Bouquetd'or.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Along with the letter... a photo—? 
Whoa...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please look over here—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Is that the child who sent it and their 
friends, perhaps? In front of the 
flowerbed... they all have such... lovely 
smiles.
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's a really great photo!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Just looking at it warms my heart. As for 
the letter, let's see...—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Hello, Bouquet-chan. Ever since I first 
watched your race, Bouquet-chan has been 
my role model."

text_block_list.name: Young Girl Fan
text_block_list.text:
"Because I think the way Bouquet-chan runs 
is so pretty, just like a flower."

text_block_list.name: Young Girl Fan
text_block_list.text:
"I love flowers so much. That's why I 
wanted to bloom a beautiful flower just 
like Bouquet-chan."

text_block_list.name: Young Girl Fan
text_block_list.text:
"While I was tending to the flowers, more 
and more friends came by and offered to 
help."

text_block_list.name: Young Girl Fan
text_block_list.text:
"We all talk about flowers together, and 
there's always so much laughter."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"It's all thanks to Bouquet-chan. So 
someday, I want to go visit Bouquet-chan 
to give her the blooming flowers."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-san... um...
choice_data_list: That was a really great letter.
That was a really great letter, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Still, I just couldn't help but 
wonder a little...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
She wrote that it was all thanks to me, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Making friends, and everyone being able to 
smile together...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to this girl's efforts. 
So—somehow, I feel a bit apologetic, 
too...
choice_data_list:
There's no doubt you were the reason it 
all started.
There's no doubt you were the catalyst

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Is that... how it is—
choice_data_list:
That's why we have to show everyone an 
even more radiant you!

That's why we have to show everyone an 
even more radiant you!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ah... Yes, absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
So that I can remain... the ideal figure 
she admires. If I just keep giving it my 
all—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'll write back right away... I'll tell 
them, "I'll do my best so you can be proud 
of me"...
